subject: School Committee Composition and Terms of Office
overview: The subcommittee discussed structural changes to the school committee, focusing on ward-based representation and term lengths. They reached a consensus on maintaining two-year terms and keeping the mayor as the chair, while proposing rotating vice chair and secretary positions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Minutes from the meeting on March 5, 2024, were approved.

items.title: Feedback from Former School Committee Member Sharon Guzik
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed feedback from former member Sharon Guzik, who favored at-large representation and retaining the mayor as the chair of the committee.

items.title: Feedback from Former Mayors McGlynn and Muccini-Burke
items.summary: Chair Van der Kloot reported that former Mayors McGlynn and Muccini-Burke both favored keeping the mayor as chair and expressed caution regarding the potential size increase of a ward-based school committee.

items.title: WRRB Brief on Worcester School Committee Representation
items.summary: The committee reviewed a report on Worcester's transition to district-based representation and noted a general trend toward moving away from strictly at-large voting systems.

items.title: School Committee Composition and Election Options
items.summary: The subcommittee explored models combining wards into four districts with two at-large seats, while awaiting guidance from the Secretary of State's Election Division regarding the legality of this configuration.

items.title: Terms of Office
items.summary: The subcommittee reached a general consensus to maintain two-year terms for school committee members, rejecting proposals for four-year or staggered terms.

items.title: Residency and Eligibility Requirements
items.summary: Members discussed residency requirements, moving toward a standard of one-year residency in Medford and current residency in the ward represented at the time of filing nomination papers.

items.title: Organization: Chair, Vice Chair, and Secretary
items.summary: The committee agreed that the mayor should serve as the chair and that the vice chair and secretary positions should rotate annually among members with no consecutive service.

items.title: Powers and Duties of the School Committee
items.summary: The committee reviewed detailed powers and duties based on the current policy handbook, with plans to refine language regarding curriculum materials and annual superintendent reviews.
